title: Schengen Short-Stay Visa
feeNote: The Schengen visa fee and visa centre service charge are paid separately.
processingTime: About 15 days after your appointment; allow longer in peak season
validity: Matches your trip dates, sometimes longer
stay: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
appointment: Appointment at the visa centre of your main destination country
imageAlt: Eiffel Tower seen from a Paris street
summary: One visa for France, Italy, Spain, Germany, the Netherlands and the rest of the Schengen Area. We handle the embassy choice, forms and travel insurance.
overview: A Schengen visa lets you travel across the 29 Schengen countries on one visa. You apply through the country where you will spend the most time, with a day-by-day plan, hotel bookings and travel insurance. We put all of this together so your application is consistent from start to finish.
requirements: Valid international passport issued in the last 10 years
Bank statements for the last 6 months
Employment letter with approved leave, or business documents
Travel insurance with at least €30,000 medical cover

steps.title: Free assessment on WhatsApp
steps.description: We confirm which embassy you should apply to and how early to start.

steps.title: Travel plan and bookings
steps.description: We prepare your itinerary, hotel and flight reservations and travel insurance.

steps.title: Application form
steps.description: We complete the form and check every document against the embassy checklist.

steps.title: Appointment
steps.description: We book your visa centre appointment.

steps.title: Decision
steps.description: We track your application and adjust your trip plans if needed.

included: Travel plan and reservations for the application

faqs.q: Which country should I apply to?
faqs.a: The country where you will spend the most nights. If the time is equal, the country you enter first. We confirm this with you.
